title: Solana Stories: BAXUS
description:
BAXUS is a global marketplace that tokenizes fine and rare spirits. So seamlessly that their oldest user is in their 80s and has no idea they're using Solana.

asr.full_text: I accidentally fell into whisky collecting. I worked at a whisky event as a staff hand, and at the end of the night they take all the open bottles, and they tip the staff with them. So I came home with an overnight whisky collection, twenty or thirty bottles. Dove right into it. It led me into this world of the inefficiency of pricing. I could buy bottles at a liquor store in New Jersey for a fraction of the cost of what we were buying it for in Manhattan, and then I started looking historically. I'm focused on 10 to 15 dollars on a flip over here but these bottles if I held them for a year or like 300 dollar increases now because they're rare. They're finite. I was this TA for this databases course. Sfee ended up taking the course. In the Zoom meeting he was the only one on camera, and had all of these whisky bottles behind him having this massive COVID beard. And I was like who is this! What is this? I basically showed her how the whiskey market works now. How these grey markets operate, how they trade on Facebook and Whatsapp groups. Totally illegally. When you have a market that's too reliant on insiders and trusts, It can't grow and scale. The value is in the bottles. It's not in the picture of the bottle. The value is the actual liquid itself. I know nothing about that point, but this seems amazing. That was like...four years ago. Voxus is an online whiskey exchange. We have our vaults, we store all of the bottles of whiskey there to authenticate them, take 360 scans of them. And that's where the tokenization process begins, because when you buy a bottle in the marketplace, it is physically sitting in their vault. We were looking for a way for barrels to be tokenized in all these different rickhouses. They are just sitting there maturing, aging, all of this capital, that is just locked in these rick houses. We met Joey from Helium. He said, decentralized wireless and I was like, what does that even mean? I was like, okay this is the solution. This is prototype number one of our IOT device that goes on barrels. They're devices that give information about ethanol percentage, airflow monitors, humidity, temperature. How cool would it be if you know where that barrel is sitting and how it's maturing? Our oldest user's in theirs, they have no idea that their using blockchain technology, and I love that. We've always thought of blockchain at Solana as just a technology that we're using. It's a suite of tools for us. I just want to buy and trade bottles more efficiently, with more transparency, globally, without having to move the bottle. If Solana didn't exist, we could not exist. We can integrate with Squads, Privy, all these different companies, and it just allows us to accomplish our goal of allowing people buy whisky.
